fields.summary_ko.0: Meta Platforms (META +0.84%) officially announced a 2-for-1 stock split effective January 19, 2027, to be executed through a dividend of new non-voting Class C shares.
fields.summary_ko.1: Meta is among the few companies capable of self-funding AI capital expenditures with its massive digital advertising business and new Muse consumer AI agent app launch, positioning it for strong long-term growth.
